query: Recent French 2027 presidential first-round voting intention polls testing Marine Le Pen by name, June-July 2026, with pollster, fieldwork dates, and Le Pen percentage. Include Ifop, Harris Interactive, Toluna, Elabe, Odoxa, IFOP polls.
answer:
I've completed the research and delivered structured findings. Here's a summary of what I found:

## Key Findings: French 2027 First-Round Polls Testing Marine Le Pen (June–July 2026)

**Critical context:** Marine Le Pen announced her candidacy on **July 7, 2026** (on TF1), right after her appeal conviction (which did not bar her from running). This split the polling window into a **pre-announcement baseline (~31–32%)** and a **post-announcement cluster (34–36%)**, reflecting a ~**+4 point** jump.

**The polls with confirmed Le Pen percentages:**

| Pollster | Client | Fieldwork | Sample | Le Pen (1st round) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Ifop-Fiducial** | LCI/Sud Radio/Le Figaro | Jul 7–8 | 984 | **36%** (+4) |
| **OpinionWay** | Les Échos/Radio Classique | Jul 8–9 | 963 | **35%** (34–36% by scenario) |
| **Toluna Harris** | M6/RTL (Wave 3) | Jul 7–8 | 1,592 reg. | **34–36%** |
| **Elabe** | BFMTV/La Tribune Dimanche | Jul 9–10 | n/a | **34–35.5%** |
| **Toluna Harris** | M6/RTL (Wave 2, baseline) | May 25–27 | 1,744 reg. | **31–32%** |
| **Odoxa** | (registered ~Jul 16) | n/a | n/a | not confirmed |

**Notes on your requested list:**
- "Ifop" and "IFOP" are the same institute (one entry above).
- "Harris Interactive" now operates as **Toluna Harris Interactive** — this covers both your "Harris Interactive" and "Toluna" requests.
- **Odoxa** ran a poll registered mid-July, but no specific first-round Le Pen figure surfaced in accessible sources.
- I did not find a distinct June-*fieldwork* poll — the window consists of the May 25–27 Toluna baseline and the July 7–11 post-announcement cluster.

In every scenario across all pollsters, Le Pen led the first round decisively; the real contest was for second place (Édouard Philippe vs. Attal/Mélenchon).
